video.title: Toggle, Slider & Picker | Day 136
video.description:
Learn to explain the SwiftUI controls on a settings screen: Toggle, Slider & Picker, with real code, a quiz at the end and each example read twice (normal, then slow).

Today's terms
Toggle - A switch that the user turns on or off.
Slider - A control that lets the user pick a number by dragging.
Picker - A control that lets the user choose one option from a list.

Quiz at the end - write your answers in the comments, then watch again to check.

landscape.title: SwiftUI Toggle, Slider & Picker | Day 136
landscape.description:
Explain Toggle, Slider & Picker in SwiftUI by listening to a real code chat between two iOS devs.
토글, 슬라이더, 피커 표현을 영어 대화로 익혀요.

Toggle - A switch that the user turns on or off.
한국어: 토글: 사용자가 켜고 끄는 스위치

Slider - A control that lets the user pick a number by dragging.
한국어: 슬라이더: 사용자가 끌어서 숫자를 고르는 컨트롤

Picker - A control that lets the user choose one option from a list.
한국어: 피커: 사용자가 목록에서 옵션 하나를 고르는 컨트롤

In this video, Mina and Jake build a settings screen, in a chat-style conversation, with the Swift code on screen.

landscape.hook: Can you explain Toggle, Slider and Picker in English?

dialogue.title: The settings screen

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Jake, I am building a settings screen. I need a switch for sound.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Use a Toggle. It is on or off.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: How does the Toggle know its value?

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: You give it a Binding. In the code I use a constant, only for a demo.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: I also want a volume control.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Use a Slider. The user drags to pick a number, like from 0 to 1.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: I used a Slider for the level, Easy or Hard, but it feels wrong.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Right, a Slider is for numbers. To choose one option, use a Picker.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: What do I put inside the Picker?

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Views with a tag, like the two Text views. The tag is the value you select.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: So the Toggle is for on or off, and the Picker is for one choice.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Yes. And the Slider is for a number in a range.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: How do I add an on and off switch?
